status.description: Status of the response i.e. success or failed

max_conversations.description: The maximum number of customer conversations the user can handle simultaneously

numbers.description: The "numbers" represents Sonetel numbers assigned to the user including the user's extension.

number_type.description:
This can take the following values

- "internal": The user's extension
- "phnum": Local number anywhere worldwide from Sonetel connected to the user

number.description: The E164 phone number. In the case of extension, it is the short number assigned to the user (usually between 3 to 5 digits).

phones.description: List of the phones (SIP phones or verified mobile numbers) linked to the user's profile that can used for answering calls.

phnum.description: The actual phone number that is used to forward incoming calls. Applied to non-SIP phones.

phone_type.description: The type of phone i.e. sip or regular

phone_name.description: User's chosen name for the phone number

receive_calls.description: Flag that indicates if incoming calls to the user should be sent to this phone. In case of SIP phones, this field is not applicable.

verified.description: Read only field Flag that indicates if the phone is verified or not

is_primary.description: Flag that indicates if this number must be used as the default for callback/callthru calls. This field is only applicable for verified mobile numbers. Only verified mobile numbers can be set as primary.

sip_details.description: Details of the SIP phones, if connected.

registered.description: Flag indicating if the SIP phone is registered

registered_since.description: The date/time since when the SIP phone is registered to Sonetel.

auto_provision.description:
Flag that indicates if the SIP phone is automatically provisioned. Sonetel ready phones can be automatically provisioned.
In the current version of the API, a phone cannot be added to Sonetel for automatic provisioning.

address.description: The SIP address of the phone. This address is automatically specified by the phone to Sonetel using SIP when it registers to Sonetel.

useragent.description: The SIP device information published by the SIP phone while registering to Sonetel.

mac.description: The MAC address of the SIP phone.

language.description: Three letter ISO code of the user's account language.

auto_translate.description: Flag to indicate whether automatic translation is turned on for the user. Reserved for future use.

language_id.description: An internal numeric code of the user's account language.

title.description: The user's job title for example, Sales Engineer, CEO, etc.

type.description: Privilege level of user i.e. admin or regular.

user_lname.description: The last name of the user.

password_status.description:
A user's access via password may be blocked if there are many attempts to use an incorrect password, either while signing in to the web portal or while connecting a SIP phone. This field indicates the current status of the password. It can take the following values.

- "ok": Indicates that access via password is OK.
- "1" or "2": There has been one(1) or two(2) attempts to connect with an incorrect password.
- "locked": The password is locked out and must be reset.

account_id.description: The Sonetel account ID of the account the user is a part of.

sonetel-id.description: User's unique id in Sonetel. This will be currently <uuid>@sonetel.com

user_id.description: Unique Id of the Sonetel user.

company_name.description: The name of the company the user is part of.

location.description: User''s location details such as country, area code and timezone.

country.description: The user's country. Has an affect on how the user dials phone numbers

timezone_id.description: An internal numeric identifier for the user's timezone.

created_date.description: The date and time the user was created.

notifications.description: The number of unread in-app notifications.
